attributes: doc = " Process-wide noteskin source cache owned by transition/worker callers."
doc = " A mutex serializes the short lookup/insert critical sections; file loading"
doc = " happens after releasing it. Entries live for the session until an explicit"
doc = " source-change clear and are bounded by encountered root/game/skin tuples."
doc = " Player Options and gameplay transitions warm the cache. A miss performs"
doc = " synchronous INI and directory I/O, so callers must not miss on gameplay"
doc = " frames. There is no incremental eviction: clearing happens at transition"
doc = " boundaries and drops `Arc`s in the clearing caller. Load errors and existing"
doc = " warnings instrument misses. A warm hit performs one lock and one borrowed"
doc = " hash lookup without allocating normalized game or skin strings."
items.name: NOTESKIN_DATA_CACHE

attributes: doc = " Process-wide lookup index for caller-owned noteskin runtimes."
doc = " The mutex makes lookup thread-safe, but entries are weak so the index never"
doc = " extends a runtime beyond its owner. The bounded Player Options service"
doc = " populates it on a worker; gameplay loads its resolved skins before the song."
doc = " The touched-key count is bounded by installed skins times encountered play"
doc = " styles and is cleared after source changes. A miss loads synchronously and"
doc = " therefore must stay on workers or transition paths, never a live frame. There is no eviction or destruction"
doc = " work here: the last owning `Arc` drops the runtime in that owner's context."
doc = " Existing loader warnings provide miss-failure instrumentation; a hit is one"
items.name: ItgSkinRuntimeCache
